notes: MXB Race Day Live v0.5.17 is a lean updater-recovery release for users whose v0.5.16 Tracks update did not complete. It forces the Tracks route and top-navigation install again even on a partially updated v0.5.16 copy, preserves the verified MXB-Shop track image/direct-link mappings, refreshes the track-image cache, and avoids re-downloading the large Windows binary payload. After installation, the updater also gains multiple GitHub binary download fallbacks, longer timeouts and clearer SHA-verified failure reporting for future releases.
